title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity?

At Fin, you will be a Senior Software Engineer - someone who solves real customer problems through a smart and efficient application of your technical knowledge and your tools. You’ll be part of one of our multidisciplinary product teams, where you will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts.

We’re facing many exciting scaling challenges and we’re building a robust platform where your expertise can be applied to areas such as building a beautiful messenger composer, rule matching, deliverability, security, app availability and machine learning, to name a few.

What will I be doing?

As an experienced engineer you will:

  • Develop technical plans and contribute to our technical architecture as we scale our products to serve tens of millions of people every day.
  • Write Ruby code, which knits together a lot of AWS, infrastructure, platform and SaaS technologies that form the core of Fin's backend infrastructure
  • Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. That “day one” change is automatically deployed to production along with 100 other deployments (on average) each weekday.
  • Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Grow your team’s capacity by mentoring other engineers and interviewing candidates. This is a chance to be an integral part of building and growing a team.

What skills do I need?

  • 5+ years of industry experience in a software engineering role, preferably building a SaaS product. You can demonstrate significant impact that your work has had on the product and/or the team.
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Javascript etc.) (If you don't know a language we use, that's okay! We think great people can learn quickly or introduce us to better ways of working.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)
  • Experience collaborating directly with product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams
  • Experience with Distributed systems

Benefits

We are a well treated bunch, with awesome benefits! If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us!

  • Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing start-up
  • We serve lunch every weekday, plus a variety of snack foods and a fully stocked kitchen
  • Regular compensation reviews - we reward great work
  • Pension scheme & match up to 4%
  • Peace of mind with life assurance, as well as comprehensive health and dental insurance for you and your dependents
  • Flexible paid time off policy
  • Paid maternity leave, as well as 6 weeks paternity leave for fathers, to let you spend valuable time with your loved ones
  • If you’re cycling, we’ve got you covered on the Cycle-to-Work Scheme. With secure bike storage too
  • MacBooks are our standard, but we also offer Windows for certain roles when needed.

#LI-Hybrid

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.

Fin values diversity and is committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity. Fin will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

title: Solutions Architect (LATAM)
description:
Join phData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

Role Overview

We are looking for a Solutions Architect – Managed Services to join our Elastic Platform Operations (EPO) team. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of cloud-native data platforms on Snowflake, AWS, and Azure for our managed services clients, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and aligned to strategic business goals. You will collaborate closely with clients, internal engineering and support teams, and practice leadership to deliver high-quality solutions, maximize platform ROI, and advance phData’s delivery excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery

  • Own and drive end-to-end solution architecture, design, and implementation of large-scale, cloud-native data platform projects on Snowflake, AWS, and Azure for managed services customers.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into secure, scalable platform solutions, including migrations from legacy platforms (e.g., Redshift, Azure Data Warehouse), integration of data lakes and data warehouses, and performance optimization of enterprise data workloads.
  • Ensure engagements are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business value by proactively optimizing platform performance, reliability, and costs through automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners across sales, engineering, and support, as well as client stakeholders including executives, to align platform strategies and roadmaps with business goals and ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership to delivery teams during migrations, integrations, incident response, and performance tuning, guiding engineers through complex implementation challenges.
  • Ensure high quality in deliverables through robust architecture standards, documentation, testing, and governance, including the implementation of strong security and data governance practices on client platforms.
  • Partner with practice and account leaders to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, preventing resource overruns, maximizing platform ROI, and reinforcing phData’s Operational Maturity Framework with clients.

Practice & Firm Contribution

  • Contribute to the evolution of phData’s Elastic Platform Operations offerings by promoting the Operational Maturity Framework, codifying best practices, and feeding lessons learned back into accelerators, templates, and playbooks.
  • Mentor and develop junior engineers, sharing best practices in cloud-native architecture, operations, and consulting to foster a culture of continuous learning and excellence.
  • Support pre-sales and scoping efforts as needed by partnering with sales and practice leadership to shape viable managed services solutions that balance technical feasibility, risk, and client value.

About You

You are a strategic, client-focused solutions architect who enjoys building and operating scalable, cloud-native data platforms that solve complex business problems. You are comfortable leading technical teams, managing multiple projects, and operating in distributed, global environments where outcomes and continuous improvement matter more than routines. You bring a hands-on mindset, strong communication skills, and a passion for aligning data infrastructure with long-term business goals.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience architecting, designing, implementing, and managing cloud-native data platforms and solutions, ideally in a consulting or managed services environment.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Deep expertise with modern enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and Azure SQL Data Warehouse, including strong skills in performance tuning and troubleshooting.
  • Strong cloud experience across AWS, Azure, and the Snowflake ecosystem, including services such as S3, ADLS, Kinesis, Azure Data Factory, dbt, and Kafka.
  • Proven ability to build and operate scalable, secure data platforms aligned to strategic business goals, with a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL and SQL-based workloads, including writing, debugging, and optimizing complex queries.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines and tooling (e.g., Bitbucket, GitHub).
  • Hands-on experience with data integration and ingestion tools such as AWS Data Migration Services, Azure Data Factory, Matillion, Fivetran, or Spark.
  • Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) with demonstrated judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct AI-generated output.
  • Ability to describe specific engineering tasks completed with AI assistance.

Consulting / Delivery Skills

  • Strong client-facing communication skills, with experience presenting architectural recommendations to executive stakeholders and creating clear, detailed solution documentation.
  • Experience delivering and managing multiple concurrent customer engagements in a professional services or consulting environment, ensuring timely delivery and optimized operations.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted advisor on data platform strategy, helping clients navigate technical trade-offs to meet business goals.
  • Ability to break down complex, ambiguous platform challenges into structured, actionable steps and drive them through to completion.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and support, to ensure seamless project delivery and high customer satisfaction.
  • Proven track record of taking ownership of outcomes, anticipating upstream data and platform changes, and proactively managing risks to minimize impact on users and systems.
  • Experience mentoring and guiding junior engineers and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.

  • Snowflake SnowPro Core certification or equivalent cloud/data platform certifications.
  • Experience using Python for task automation, tooling, and operational efficiency in cloud-native environments.
  • Hands-on experience with automated database deployment and CI/CD frameworks such as Flyway or Liquibase.
  • Advanced degrees or additional relevant certifications in data, cloud, or software engineering disciplines.
  • Experience supporting or implementing managed services offerings for cloud-native data platforms and working with global, remote teams.

Location & Time Zone Expectations

This role is based in LATAM and operates primarily in Eastern US time zone with significant overlap with Central time zone.

  • We are a remote-first company, and you should be comfortable working with a distributed global team.
  • Some flexibility may be required to collaborate across time zones with colleagues and clients.
  • Client needs may occasionally require flexibility in working hours to support key milestones or workshops.

Why phData?

  • Impactful Work: Partner with leading organizations on meaningful data & AI initiatives.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work with a supportive, high-performing global team that values transparency, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Access to challenging projects, mentorship, and structured development pathways.

Benefits at phData

title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst - BCBA (Part-time)
description:
Title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) Hybrid Remote

Location: Burlington, MA

At Cortica, our Board-Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) use a strength-based, holistic approach to clinical programming for children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences. Our valued BCBAs are leaders who make a difference and create a supportive environment where all clinicians in our transdisciplinary team can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful, long-term impact for families.

You’ll provide groundbreaking, neurodiversity-affirming care, while enjoying the flexibility and support you deserve.


Why Choose Cortica?

We’re excited to support your continued professional development, growth, well-being, and ability to make a meaningful impact as part of a transdisciplinary team. That's why our compensation and benefits package has been designed to support you personally and professionally:

  • Compensation: $70/hr - $80/hr

  • Flexible Hybrid Role: We offer remote flexibility, allowing you to balance your clinical work and administrative tasks on your terms. Telehealth is determined by the BCBA when it's clinically effective for the client and BT.

  • License Reimbursement: We cover the cost of your BCBA license renewal.

  • 401(k) Matching: Helping you plan for your future with matching contributions.

  • Set Scheduling: Predictable work hours help you balance your work and personal life.

Your Role and Impact

As a BCBA at Cortica, you’ll play a pivotal role in overseeing neurodiversity-affirming clinical programming for patients receiving ABA treatment. You'll lead a team of behavior technicians (BTs), empowering them to make a lasting difference in the lives of children with developmental differences.

What you’ll love about this role:

  • Growth and Advancement Opportunities: You'll have the chance to advance through BCBA levels I, II, III, and IV, increasing your leadership impact along the way. At BCBA levels III and IV, productivity targets are reduced to 22, allowing you to focus on developing leadership skills, cultivating other talents, and exploring broader professional interests.
  • Autonomy over Your Schedule: You’ll have full control over when and where you supervise your cases, empowering you to design a schedule that works for you.
  • Administrative Support: Focus on what you do best—clinical care—while our dedicated team handles scheduling, billing, and credentialing, leaving you with more time to focus on your work and patients.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Master’s degree in human services or a related field.
  • Current BCBA (Board-Certified Behavior Analyst) Certification required.

What Makes Cortica Different from Other ABA Companies?

At Cortica, we believe in going beyond traditional ABA practices to offer a more comprehensive, patient-centered approach that is different from other ABA companies:

  • A Transdisciplinary Approach to Care: Unlike many ABA companies that focus solely on behavior therapy, Cortica offers a holistic, multidisciplinary model of care. Our team includes experts from a wide range of fields—occupational therapy, speech pathology, pediatrics, and more—allowing us to address the whole child and deliver more integrated, effective care.
  • Focus on Collaboration: At Cortica, we don’t just implement therapy—we collaborate with families, caregivers, and other clinicians to create individualized care plans that empower everyone involved. This approach ensures that each child’s unique needs are met, and that the entire team is aligned in their goals for success.
  • Quality Over Quantity: We take pride in value-based care partnerships with health plans that prioritize quality over quantity. Our patients benefit from the time we dedicate to collaborative, integrated care, and our clinicians are supported with more time for thoughtful clinical decision-making. Unlike other providers, we are reimbursed based on outcomes, not just the number of sessions delivered.

By joining Cortica, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining ABA therapy—combining compassion, innovation, and collaboration to deliver results that matter.

Ready to make a difference? Apply today to learn more.

Cortica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This posting is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Please review the full job description here: Job Description.

title: Director of Emerging Architecture
description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Director of Emerging Architecture to serve as a technical leader within the Federal Civilian CTO organization. This role combines direct pursuit responsibility on the most large, complex, and strategic opportunities ($75M–$1B+ TCV) with a broader mandate to shape how the sector applies emerging technology across pursuits, delivery, and practice development.

The Director will partner with Capture Managers, Proposal Managers, Business Development, Subject Matter Experts, Peraton Labs, and executive leadership to develop innovative, mission-focused solutions that align with customer missions, technical requirements, and strategic objectives. Beyond individual pursuits, the Director will lead the sector's technology council, drive emerging-technology adoption across the Lead Solution Architect community and develop reusable architecture patterns and reference designs that scale across the portfolio.

The ideal candidate combines deep enterprise architecture experience across cloud, cybersecurity, application modernization, data analytics, artificial intelligence, IT operations, and managed services environments with the ability to identify, evaluate, and integrate emerging technologies into winning federal civilian solutions.

Work Location: Reston, Virginia. Flexibility with travel to customer sites as needed.

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Develop forward-looking architectures with evolutionary pathways for emerging technologies and translate them into pursuit-ready patterns.
  • Lead the Federal Civilian Technology Council, setting the agenda and driving working outputs including reference architectures, decision frameworks, and technology position whitepapers.
  • Evaluate Peraton Labs capabilities and partner technologies for inclusion in solutions; develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and solution accelerators that scale across the technical community.
  • Mentor Principal, Senior, and Mid-level Solution Architects; establish technical review standards that elevate the practice, and partner with other directors on productization pathways emerging from pursuit work.
  • Own and oversee solution architecture on large strategic federal civilian pursuits ($75M–$1B+), from capture through proposal submission as needed.
  • Design enterprise architectures spanning cloud, application modernization, cybersecurity, data, AI, IT operations, and managed services tailored to customer missions.
  • Author and review technical proposal volumes - ensuring content is compelling, compliant, and discriminating against evaluation criteria.
  • Conduct competitive technical analysis and articulate discriminators that create measurable separation from competitors.
  • Develop deep understanding of assigned customer missions, technology environments, and strategic direction; engage directly with federal customers as a trusted advisor.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 16 years of experience, may have management experience
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • 5+ years as a solution architect or similar role on large enterprise-level pursuits ($100M+ TCV) with end-to-end solution design responsibility.
  • Demonstrated architecture experience across at least four domains: cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI), app modernization, cybersecurity/zero trust, data/AI-ML, IT ops, DevSecOps, enterprise platforms, etc.
  • Proven track record winning large competitive proposals - translating complex requirements into deliverable, discriminating solutions.

title: Research Administrator
description:
The Research Administrator for the Department of Medical Oncology and the Divisions of Molecular and Cellular Oncology and Solid Tumors RA is responsible for the management of the research portfolio(s) for one or more laboratories (and Disease Centers, as applicable) with direction and moderate supervision from their supervisor.

The RA works with a diverse set of funding types including federal, industry, foundation, donor, institutional, chargeback, and clinical trials.

The RA collaborates with faculty and researchers on the preparation of sponsored research applications and/or the financial management of sponsored and institutional funds; and is responsible for identifying problems and working with supervisor to resolve where necessary.

The RA is responsible for liaising with Institute central offices such as Research Finance, Accounts Payable, Research Administration, Special Funds, Grants and Contracts, the Clinical Trials Office, Office of General Counsel, and the Innovations Office.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Responsibilities

Pre-Award Management

  • Proactively works with faculty and/or professional staff to identify funding opportunities and prepare applications for grants in compliance with sponsor guidelines and Institute standards for excellence and timeliness.
  • Responsible for the timely and accurate completion of entire proposal (excluding scientific content) for accuracy, presentation, and compliance. This includes but is not limited to all administrative pages, narratives for non-scientific areas of the grant (e.g., data sharing plan, resource sharing plan, human subjects, vertebrate animals, etc.), and appendices
  • Responsible for oversight of grant submittal process, including monitoring the application review process and submitting supplemental information. Works with faculty to review summary sheets and plan responses/revised applications, if applicable, and complete any JIT or program requests.
  • Assists with all progress reports and ensures compliance and responsiveness with sponsor guidelines and requests.

Portfolio Management (post-award)

  • Upon award, finalizes the budget and works with Grants & Contracts and Research Accounting to get the award set up properly in a timely manner.
  • Reviews Notice of Award for any budgetary or other restrictions/requirements. Works with faculty to assure understanding of reporting and other requirements of PI.
  • Reviews budget adjustments, restrictions, required responses with faculty and ensures a timely response to the sponsor.
  • Manages budget spending to guidelines, monitoring and reviewing allocation of research funds, grant balances and charges, ensuring appropriate use of funds under investigator control, both in terms of sponsor/external regulations and Institute policy. Calculates overhead and fringe benefit charges; purchases equipment; ensures payment of salaries; and generates spreadsheets.
  • Compiles and analyzes fiscal data; develops updates, disseminates accurate and complete financial information to ensure compliance with all requirements of externally funded programs, performs related duties as assigned.

Procurement

  • May approve and/or initiate purchase requests for investigators and laboratory members via Purchase Orders and PCard
  • Verify funds are available, expenses are allowable and correctly allocated in a timely manner
  • Review and approve bills for core and center services

Human Resources

Onboarding:

  • Conduct financial analysis to determine availability of funding
  • Assist in the development of job descriptions
  • Post positions and approve salary offers
  • Process visa applications and payments as appropriate

Ongoing:

  • Process merit, equity and promotions requests
  • Manage salary allocations in adherence to funding guidelines and availability

Offboarding:

  • Manage termination process checklist, process termination paperwork

Compliance

  • Partners with faculty and researchers to ensure adherence to internal and external policies; this includes consulting with faculty/OGC/Innovations on MTA, DUA and consulting agreement processes
  • Advise faculty and researchers and/or refer them to appropriate resources for other compliance issues such as financial conflict of interest and foreign influence
  • Manage the federal time and effort process for applicable researchers

Qualifications

  • High school diploma required; Bachelor’s degree preferred;

  • 0-1 year of related experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Computer literacy: Familiarity with new applications and software programs. Familiarity with Excel/ Google Sheets preferred.

  • Organization: Familiar with electronic document and email file storage. Able to complete projects on time with support and direction from supervisor. Familiar with prioritization and balancing workload.

  • Customer Service: Provides clear written and verbal communication. Listens and asks clarifying questions.

  • Financial: Familiarity with Excel /G-Sheets and budgeting principles, including projections.

  • Ability to analyze grant data through research, comprehension and application of regulations, policies, and procedures.

  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. Ability to cultivate relationships with faculty, research staff, department’s GM team, GM in other departments, and central departments.

  • Institute operations and processes: Familiarity directing faculty and researchers to appropriate departmental and institutional resources.

  • Inclusion, Diversity & Equity: Promotes inclusive community where human differences are valued and celebrated and where all are welcome.

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. title: Medical Lab Scientist Resident
description:
Overview

A training position preparing individuals to gain certification. Residents will work under the supervision of a Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS), Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS), or Medical Technologist (MT) in providing technical and non-technical laboratory services.

Position will offer eligibility for categorical or generalist certification after one year of approved clinical laboratory experience.

Categorical residents will train for 3 months (12 weeks) in the desired area of specialty. Specialty areas include Chemistry, Hematology, Microbiology, or Blood Banking. At a year of employment, the resident will be eligible to apply as Technologists for certification examination in area of specialty. Categorical certificates would qualify residents to work only in area of specialty within the clinical laboratory.

Generalist residents will train in all areas of the lab equating to one year. At a year of employment, the resident will be eligible to apply as a Technologist for the generalist certification examination. Generalist certificates would qualify residents to work in all areas of the clinical laboratory.

Responsibilities

  • Adhere to requirements set forth in the curriculum to meet certification eligibility at the conclusion of program. Responsible for completing all assigned lecture material and/or assignments by indicated deadlines.

  • Operates laboratory equipment and reviews and assists in performing specimen testing (including chemistry, coagulation, hematology, special chemistry, urinalysis, blood bank, serology, immunology, bacteriology, microbiology, referral testing and more) under the supervision of a MLS or MT.

  • Performs laboratory tests, and investigates and troubleshoots test results and/or system

    • failures. Reports events or situations with specimens which may lead to adverse test outcomes.

  • Supports departmental QA program by performing and documenting quality control and preventative maintenance. Investigates resolves and documents quality control or instrument maintenance problems.

  • Complies with positive patient identification procedures to ensure the integrity of each specimen for pre-analytical, analytical and post-analytical testing.

  • Performs all clerical duties to initiate the processing of specimens and the reporting of results including but not limited to proper specimen collection, labeling, handling, preservation or fixation, processing or preparation, transportation and storage.
  • Communicates with other departments and staff, including physicians and other medical staff, to facilitate the flow and quality of lab work. Completes and post results accurately and in a timely manner and distributes information stored in the LIS.

  • Keeps work area clean, stocked and organized. Uses and maintains tools and equipment in compliance with laboratory policies and standards.

  • Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.

  • Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with hospital and departmental policies and procedures. Immediately reports any mechanical or electrical equipment malfunctions, unsafe conditions, or employee/patient/visitor injury‑accident to Manager.

    • Qualifications

    KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES/LICENSE OR CERTIFICATION REQUIRED

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical, physical or biological science.
  • Ability to perform clinical laboratory procedures according to proper standards and regulations.
  • Must submit to a Color-Acuity screening Test

    • KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES/LICENSE OR CERTIFICATION PREFERRED

    Experience in a Clinical Laboratory Setting

    Work Hours:

    6a - 230p

description:
RN/LVN Homecare

Job Overview

Title

Registered Nurse/Licensed Vocational Nurse- Non-Exempt

Job Summary

Registered Nurse/Licensed Vocational Nurse is responsible for providing and documenting skilled nursing care and reports to Case Managers and Clinical Nurse Supervisor. In collaboration with the MGA personnel, RN will render skilled nursing care in accordance with the care developed for each individual patient and in accordance with Physician’s orders.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides skilled nursing as ordered on the plan of treatment and nursing care plan.
  • Demonstrates and documents clinical skills.
    • Each shift or visit reflects the provision of skilled nursing care rendered in accordance with physician’s orders
    • New Problems, changes, and/or resolution of problems are identified and followed through as follows:
      • Director/Supervisory notification
      • Physical notification to obtain necessary orders for intervention(s) per stat regulations
      • Documentation of same on clinical notes, supplemental physician orders and nursing care plan
      • Observe aseptic technique as required
      • Performs specific treatments and medication administration as per care plan
  • Functions as a team member demonstrating collaboration with and responsibility to the patient, Physician, and health care team.
  • Identifies issues of concern and demonstrates critical thinking skills.
  • Displays correct skilled nursing care that reflects compliance with State, Federal regulations.
  • Performs related work as assigned.
  • Participation in the Agency’s other mandated activities as requested by the Agency’s Director such as In-Services, education and committee work related to patient care.
  • Supports and executes the mission, ethics, and goals of the company effectively
    • All clinical documentation must be completed accurately and submitted timely per agency policy/guidelines.
    • Represents themselves in a positive and professional manner in the company and community.
    • Adheres to dress code with a clean and neat professional appearance.
    • Reports on time and as scheduled in order to complete work within designated time.
    • Adhere to all company policies and procedures outlines in the Employee Handbook, Employees Agreement, or communicated from executive team


Requirements

  • Graduation from an approved certification/program/accredited school/undergraduate/graduate school or post graduate education to reflect ability to perform job as described.
  • Hold a valid/unencumbered verification/license to practice the job as described in the state where services are provided.
  • Have professional experience as required per state regulations to perform the job as described.
  • Successful completion of assigned screening/competency testing with a proficiency score of 80% or greater.
  • Reliable transportation.
  • Provide copy of current TB results or Chest x-ray.
  • Provide copy of current CPR certification as per agency policy.
  • Be flexible, organized and have the ability to exercise independent and sound judgment to perform the job duties/responsibilities.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to regularly, sit, stand, stop, bend, kneel, walk, balance, crouch, crawl, push, pull and reach with hands and arms and other physical activities as deemed necessary buy job duties.

description:

Responsibilities

  • Monitor non-scheduled work for possible corrective actions through PM or routine inspections.
  • Maintain and audit Preventive Maintenance work orders.
  • Lead the planning, scheduling, communication and optimization of down days and non-down days activities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in maintenance-related applications.
  • High School Diploma or GED

Physical Requirements

  • Willing and able to perform tasks such as lifting, walking, climbing, stooping, standing, pushing and/or pulling for up to twelve (12) hours a day

  • Willing and able to pull and lift, up to 50 lbs.

Job Summary

Under general supervision, supervises, coordinates and participates in activities of workers engaged in various phases of construction or maintenance, and repair of county roadways, bridges, and related structures and equipment by performing the following duties.

Job Description

All candidates conditionally offered transfer, promotion or initial hiring into a DOT/safety-sensitive position shall submit to testing for drugs and alcohol and test negative before performing any job functions that are safety-sensitive or require a CDL. Direct workers in projects, such as construction of ditches and roadways, and grading drainage areas. Operate or supervise workers operating equipment to lay drainage tile, cut grades, clean and clear barrow ditches. Supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in excavating and grading right of way for construction of projects such as highways, streets, ditches or bridges. Keep roadways passable in severe weather or marked when impassable. Participate in and oversee activities of employees who erect, repair and maintain traffic warning signs. Coordinate and direct activities of workers engaged in spreading, rolling and tamping bituminous materials such as asphalt or similar materials, to form surfaces of roadways. Supervise and coordinate activities of work crews engaged in preparing and applying concrete for repair or fabrication, covering and reinforcing structures such as bridges, roads and culverts. title: Enterprise Application Integration Developer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Summary

AST SpaceMobile is seeking an iPaaS / Integration Engineer to join our Enterprise Applications team, specializing in the design, delivery, and operational maintenance of enterprise integrations across our manufacturing and business systems. As the platform of record for enterprise integration, Boomi orchestrates the critical data flows that connect our ERP (NetSuite), PLM (Fusion Manage and Windchill), MES (Tulip), and adjacent SaaS applications. The successful candidate will design, develop, configure, implement, and maintain integration processes, connectors, and API-based data flows that ensure reliable, auditable, and near real-time data movement between systems of record and downstream analytics and reporting layers.

This role sits at the center of the enterprise data fabric: upstream, it consumes structured and event-driven data from ERP, PLM, MES, and third-party SaaS systems; downstream, it feeds the data lake ingestion layer (bronze) and operational integrations with peer systems. The successful candidate owns everything between the system of record and the analytics/consumer boundary — integration flow design, data contracts, transformation logic, error handling, replay, monitoring, and governance — while collaborating closely with the Data Lake Engineer, whose scope covers curation of bronze, silver, and gold layers. This role also serves as AST's primary technical owner of the Boomi platform relationship, coordinating and supervising Boomi vendor and professional services engagements to support AST operations while progressively building internal capability and reducing external delivery dependency. This role partners with ERP, PLM, MES, security, and enterprise architecture teams to translate business and operational needs into robust, maintainable, and secure integration solutions that scale across AST's multi-site, multi-entity manufacturing footprint.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, configure, and maintain Boomi integration processes, connectors, and API-based flows across NetSuite (ERP), Fusion Manage and Windchill (PLM), Tulip (MES), Epsilon3, and adjacent SaaS applications supporting manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and finance.
  • Serve as AST's primary technical owner of the Boomi platform relationship; supervise and coordinate Boomi vendor and professional services engagements, scoping their work, managing deliverables, and driving effective knowledge transfer to internal staff.
  • Administer the Boomi environment (Atmosphere, runtimes/molecules, environments, and connections), including user and role management, environment promotion, credentials and secrets, and monitoring/alerting configuration.
  • Build, publish, and govern reusable APIs, connectors, and data contracts; establish integration patterns (event-driven, batch, request/response, pub-sub) and standards that scale across the enterprise application portfolio.
  • Own end-to-end integration lifecycle — requirements, technical design, build, testing (including UAT), deployment, and hypercare — with clear traceability from business need to production process.
  • Establish and monitor SLAs for integration flows: implement structured logging, error handling, retry/replay, dead-letter queues, and proactive alerting; own MTTR for integration incidents.
  • Feed the data lake bronze layer with clean, well-typed, auditable data extracts and change-data streams; partner with the Data Lake Engineer to define ingestion contracts, schemas, and data quality expectations at the source-to-lake boundary.
  • Document integration architecture, data flows, connector inventories, and runbooks; maintain a living integration catalog and governance model across multi-site operations (US, Israel, Spain, India).
  • Support compliance requirements (ITAR, CUI, CMMC) in integration design: enforce data residency, secure credential handling, encryption in transit and at rest, and least-privilege access across integration endpoints.
  • Evaluate and, where appropriate, extend the iPaaS/orchestration footprint (e.g., Celigo, event brokers, workflow orchestrators) as business needs evolve; contribute to the technology roadmap and tooling decisions.
  • Serve as the primary Jira support contact for integration and iPaaS requests; manage ticket triage, tracking, and reporting to Enterprise Applications and IT leadership.
  • Mentor peers, application owners, and business analysts on integration best practices, API contracts, and Boomi-specific patterns; drive continuous improvement across enterprise integration operations.
  • Assist with Boomi license usage optimization, connection sizing, and cost control for integration tooling.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise integrations, including at least 3 years on a mainstream iPaaS platform (Boomi strongly preferred; MuleSoft, Workato, SnapLogic, or Talend acceptable with willingness to work as the primary Boomi practitioner).
  • Proven experience integrating ERP systems (NetSuite preferred; SAP, Oracle, or equivalent acceptable) with PLM and MES systems in a manufacturing environment.
  • Expertise in REST and SOAP APIs, webhook and event-driven patterns, message queuing, and real-time data synchronization; solid understanding of authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, mTLS, SAML).
  • Strong SQL and scripting skills (Python, JavaScript, or Groovy); comfort building transformation logic, error-handling routines, and reusable components inside the iPaaS platform.
  • Working knowledge of ISA-95 (enterprise-control system integration) concepts and enterprise architecture principles/frameworks such as TOGAF (or equivalent), applied to aligning ERP, PLM, and MES data models and system integrations.
  • Familiarity with data lake / lakehouse concepts (bronze/silver/gold, ELT patterns, change-data-capture) and how upstream integration quality affects downstream analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, produce technical solution designs, perform testing (including UAT), and deliver production-ready implementations with appropriate documentation and runbooks.
  • Experience with change management, environment promotion, source control for integration artifacts, and integration governance.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage third-party technology vendors and professional services engagements, including scoping, oversight, and knowledge-transfer planning.
  • Skilled in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project) and capable of working across multiple web platforms and admin consoles.
  • Strong analytical and technical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently or in fast-paced, cross-functional teams; leadership experience preferred.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Boomi Professional or Architect-level certification.
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite SuiteQL, SuiteScript, or NetSuite Boomi/Celigo connectors.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), containerization, and event streaming (Kafka, EventBridge, or equivalent).
  • Prior work in aerospace, defense, or other regulated industries; familiarity with ITAR, CUI, and CMMC controls applied to integration endpoints.

Technology Stack

  • Integration Platform: Boomi (Atmosphere, AtomSphere API, Flow, Master Data Hub as applicable); Celigo where deployed; potential future iPaaS/orchestration additions.
  • Systems of Record: NetSuite (ERP), Fusion Manage and Windchill (PLM), Tulip (MES); Jira/Atlassian for work management; other SaaS as onboarded.
  • Downstream Consumers: Enterprise data lake (bronze/silver/gold layers), reporting/BI (Power BI preferred), and adjacent operational applications.
  • Protocols & Patterns: REST, SOAP, OData, SFTP, webhooks, change-data-capture, event-driven and batch integration patterns.
  • Collaboration & Analytics: Jira for task management; Power BI for analytics (preferred); PagerDuty for alerting.
  • Security & Compliance: ITAR / CUI / CMMC-aligned integration controls; secure credential management, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging.

Work Location & Schedule

On-site in Midland, TX. Minimum, remote flexibility may be evaluated.

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands.

  • Excellent communication skills, both in person and over the phone, with proven ability to tailor features and benefits of products and services to clients with differing needs.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R208[

At Databricks, our customers challenge us with solving some of the world's toughest data problems. Our customers rely on our Solutions Architect team to understand the technologies that power our platform, the broader cloud and technology ecosystems, and how they can all be brought together to solve these problems.

Solutions Architects at Databricks lead the adoption of the Databricks Unified Analytics Platform. As a member of our team, you will sharpen your skills on open-source projects such as Apache Spark™, MLflow, and Delta Lake to advocate the Lakehouse paradigm on public cloud providers. You will gain expertise in cloud platforms, data engineering, data analytics, data science, and machine learning. In this customer-facing role, you will identify use cases for Databricks, develop architectures and solutions using our platform, and guide customers through implementations to deliver strategic business value. You will partner with the sales team to build relationships with our customers and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

Databricks' culture thrives on collaboration and teamwork, and you will contribute your knowledge to our teams by participating in our subject matter expert groups. In this role, you will report to the Solutions Architect Leader supporting the specific business segment.

If you are a technologist interested in Data and AI, and enjoy prototyping solutions for customers, this role is for you.

The impact you will have:

  • Provide technical leadership for customers to evaluate and adopt Data and AI solutions from Databricks
  • Consult on big data architecture, implement proof of concepts for strategic customer projects, data science and machine learning projects, and validate integrations with cloud services and other 3rd party applications
  • Build and present reference architectures, technical guides, and demo applications for customers
  • Provide escalated support for critical customer operational issues

Solution Architects are customer-facing. You'll need to be comfortable communicating ideas to various audiences through presentations, whiteboarding, architecture discussions, and platform demonstrations.

  • Comfortable programming in and debugging at least one of Python, Scala, Java, SQL, or R

    • Data Engineering technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Director of Engineering

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering oversees all process/manufacturing engineering functions within a high-mix, high-reliability PCBA manufacturing environment producing Class 3 aerospace and mission-critical assemblies. This role leads PCBA manufacturing engineering, process engineering, NPI, DFM/DFX, sustaining engineering, and automation/continuous improvement initiatives. The Director ensures that all engineering processes comply with IPC, J-STD, AS9100, and aerospace customer addendums while optimizing manufacturability, quality, cost, and throughput.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team (SMT Process, Manufacturing, New Product Introduction, and Automation).
  • Drive engineering strategy aligned with company objectives for quality, cost, yield, and delivery.
  • Serve as the technical authority for IPC-J-STD-001 Class 3, IPC-A-610 Class 3, IPC-7711/7721, and aerospace process controls.

Manufacturing / Process Engineering

  • Own company-wide engineering initiatives across all PCBA manufacturing functional areas, including build readiness reviews and standardization efforts.
  • Ensure process qualification and documentation aligns with J-STD-001 Space & Military Addendum and applicable aerospace customer requirements.
  • Establish and maintain process windows, control plans, PFMEAs, and validation reports.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Lead DFM/DFX reviews, tooling design, stencil strategy, and prototype builds.
  • Oversee creation of travelers, BOM validation, build instructions, and work instructions in compliance with AS9100.
  • Manage engineering change control (ECOs), configuration management, and revision control.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead LEAN/CI programs focused on waste reduction, defect elimination, and throughput improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Quality Engineering to address defects, root cause investigations, and MRB activities.
  • Implement process monitoring, SPC, and industry 4.0 tools.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Production, Quality, Program Management, Supply Chain, and SMT departments.
  • Provide engineering support during customer audits, FAIs, PFMEAs, and technical reviews.
  • Partner with external suppliers on polymerics, tooling, fixtures, materials, and new process technologies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10-15+ years in PCBA manufacturing engineering with at least 10+ years in a leadership role.
  • Deep knowledge of:
    • IPC-J-STD-001 Class 3 & Space/Military Addendums
    • IPC-A-610 Class 3
    • AS9100D
    • IPC-7351, 7711/7721, 2221
  • Experience with aerospace, defense, medical, or other high-reliability electronics.
  • Strong background in SMT (printing, placement, reflow), AOI/AXI, DFM/DFX, Rework, Chemical Wash, Polymerics, and test strategies.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and technical decision-making abilities.

Pay Range
$150,000—$200,000 USD

title: MAX Västervik söker restaurangbiträde
description:
Vi vill bli världens bästa burgarkedja och vi vet att vägen dit går genom engagerade medarbetare, starka team, grym service och riktigt goda burgare. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass vid varje besök.

Som restaurangbiträde på MAX är du en nyckelperson i vårt dagliga arbete. Tillsammans med dina kollegor ser du till att våra gäster får bästa möjliga bemötande och att restaurangen alltid levererar på högsta nivå. Både när det gäller kvalitet, tempo och service. Du arbetar i team och har varierande arbetsuppgifter: du serverar gäster, håller rent och snyggt i restaurangen, jobbar i köket med att laga burgare och pommes, och ansvarar för kassan där du ser till att gästerna får det som beställts varor. Hos oss är arbetsglädje, gemenskap och utveckling alltid i centrum. Så under dina första dagar lär du dig jobbet steg för steg av din restaurangchef eller en erfaren kollega och på vår lärplattform MAX Academy via digitala utbildningar.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Servera gäster, ge ett schyst bemötande och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass
  • Hålla rent och snyggt i restaurangen
  • Laga burgare, smoothies och pommes i köket
  • Ansvara för kassan och se till att gästerna får det som beställts
  • Arbeta i team och stötta dina kollegor

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Ett fartfyllt jobb i ett sammansvetsat team med mycket goda möjligheter att växa och utvecklas
  • Interna utbildningar och tydliga karriärvägar
  • Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal samt friskvårdsbidrag
  • En arbetsplats där bemötandet, goda burgare, en ren och fräsch restaurang och snabb service alltid står i fokus
  • En kultur där vi lägger stor vikt vid hälsa, miljö och socialt ansvar

Hur går processen till?

För våra tjänster som restaurangmedarbetare har vi valt ett enklare och mer relevant sätt att söka jobb. Det betyder att du inte behöver skicka in CV eller personligt brev. I stället får du svara på några urvalsfrågor och genomföra ett Servicetest. Vi rekommenderar att du svarar så utförligt och ärligt du kan på frågorna.

När du har skickat in din ansökan får du ett mejl med en länk till Servicetestet. Testet består av olika situationer som kan uppstå i vardagen på MAX, där du får beskriva hur du skulle agera. På så sätt får du redan tidigt en bra bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss. Testet tar cirka 15 minuter att genomföra.

När vi har gått igenom både din ansökan och ditt test återkopplar vi till dig så snart vi kan. Går du vidare i processen blir du inbjuden till intervju. Om du inte går vidare får du besked via mejl. Vi hanterar ansökningarna löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Observera att Servicetestet är ett obligatoriskt steg i vår rekryteringsprocess och att vi därför inte kan ta kandidater vidare som inte genomför testet.

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Vill du läsa om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter? Gå in på www.max.se/dataskydd

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Estimator - Centerville, UT
description:
Title: Estimator

Location: Centerville, UT


We help homeowners and businesses restore their properties - and peace of mind - after unexpected damage. As an Estimator with Paul Davis Restoration, you’ll work with customers who have experienced damage from water, fire, mold, storms, or other incidents. This is a key role where you’ll support customers during challenging situations and help guide the restoration process. We’re looking for reliable, hardworking professionals who are dedicated to helping others and take pride in their work.


What does an Estimator do?

The Estimator works with property owners, insurance adjusters, and project managers to assess damage from events such as fire or water loss. In this role, you will use tools like Matterport to document job sites, evaluate the scope of work, and prepare accurate estimates for restoration projects. You will also communicate with insurance professionals to review and finalize estimates and help move projects forward.


Job Responsibilities

  • Communicate with adjusters, insurance partners, and team members throughout each project
  • Prepare, review, and update estimates using tools and project information (e.g., photos, measurements, and plans)
  • Track and meet goals for estimate turnaround time, quality, and customer service
  • Document and manage change orders and estimate updates as needed
  • Ensure projects meet company guidelines, timelines, and profitability goals
  • Follow program and insurance requirements
  • Assist with project documentation and support the collections process


Basic Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience as a restoration/mitigation estimator or insurance professional
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent industry experience
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Self-motivated with strong attention to detail
  • Good verbal and written communication skills
  • Positive attitude and ability to work well on a team
  • Able to stay organized, prioritize tasks, and solve problems
  • Familiarity with different insurance carriers and their required guidelines
  • Familiarity with Matterport and Hover software required
  • Familiarity with XactAnalysis and XactContents
  • Familiarity with MICA and dry out logs
  • Familiarity with Symbility and Claims Workspace


Working Conditions

  • Remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods while working on a computer
  • Adjusting or moving objects up to 20 pounds in all directions
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers


Benefits

  • 3 weeks of paid time off
  • 8 company paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, supplemental, and disability insurance offered
  • On-the-job training to develop new skills

title: SMT Operator (Second Shift)
description:
SMT Operator

About the Role

As an SMT Operator at Rocket EMS, you will be responsible for operating and supporting surface mount technology (SMT) production processes to ensure high-quality, reliable PCB assemblies. You’ll work hands-on with automated equipment and collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, and Production teams to maintain process accuracy, throughput, and compliance with customer and industry standards.

What You’ll Do

  • Set up, operate, and monitor SMT equipment, including solder paste printers, pick-and-place machines, reflow ovens, and supporting automation.

  • Load and unload printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) while following ESD, MSD, and handling requirements.

  • Verify correct component placement, orientation, and solder quality during production runs.

  • Identify and report defects such as missing components, misalignment, solder defects, or process deviations.

  • Follow travelers, MPIs, work instructions, and production schedules to ensure builds meet customer specifications.

  • Perform first-piece checks and in-process inspections as required.

  • Assist with basic machine maintenance, nozzle changes, feeder setup, and cleanliness.

  • Communicate issues, pass-downs, and improvement opportunities to leads, supervisors, and engineers.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring defects or process trends.

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in SMT or electronics manufacturing preferred.

  • Familiarity with SMT equipment (pick-and-place, reflow, printers, AOI/AXI) is a plus.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

  • Ability to follow detailed work instructions and IPC standards (IPC-A-610 preferred).

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented manufacturing environment.

  • Willingness to learn new processes and adapt to changing production needs.

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a high-reliability electronics manufacturing team supporting aerospace, defense, and advanced technology programs. Your work directly impacts product quality, performance, and mission success—down to every component placed on the board.

Pay Range
$20—$25 USD

Rocket EMS will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the California Fair Chance Act. Candidates are not required to disclose criminal history or participate in a background check unless and until a conditional offer of employment has been made. Any final offer of employment may be conditioned on completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law.

title: Rental and Repair Shop Supervisor
description:
Rental/Repair Shop Supervisor

Since 1978, Big Tool Box has been the family-owned hardware haven where “all the expertise is under one roof,” putting customer service at the heart of everything it does. Spanning five powerhouse categories—Ace Hardware and Tools for every nut, bolt, and power tool imaginable; the Rental & Repair Center to keep projects moving without breaking the bank; the Highlands Garden Center bursting with plants, soil, and green-thumb guidance; the Lawn & Sprinkler Center for flawless outdoor irrigation and landscape solutions; and the Grillin and Chillin Center stocked with premium BBQ grills and all the accessories for perfect backyard cookouts—Big Tool Box remains the go-to destination for contractors, gardeners, grill masters, and DIYers alike.

Job Summary

  • Lead the Rental and Repair Shop as the in-store expert on equipment rentals, small-engine/battery repairs, screen fabrication, and propane sales while driving revenue through people leadership, writing schedules, ordering parts and supplies, and personally modeling exceptional customer service behaviors.
  • Oversee a team of Rental/Repair Sales Associates and Technicians to deliver clean, safe, on-time rentals and “better-than-new” repairs with maximum add-on sales and zero customer wait.
  • Full-time hourly leadership role with Rental POS admin rights, parts vendor portals, propane compliance.
  • Praise worthy customer service is our goal in every customer interaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • People Leadership & Development
    • Hire, onboard, train, and write weekly schedules for 4–8 associates and technicians covering rentals, repairs, propane, and screen clinic.
    • Conduct daily 10-minute huddles: review hot rentals, repair backlog, propane goals, add-on targets, and safety topics.
    • Coach live: shadow a rental demo, repair diagnosis, or propane fill; recognize top closers and correct gaps instantly.
  • Modeling Customer Service Behaviors
    • Personally greet contractors at open, jump counter during rushes, demo safe operation, carry pressure washers to vehicles, and turn complaints into 5-star recoveries.
    • Set the standard: every customer gets a smile + name, Ace Rewards pitch, add-on offer, and “thank you for choosing us.”
    • Train and enforce 10-foot/10-second rule, carry-out offers, and repair status updates within 24 hrs.
  • Ordering Parts and Supplies
    • Forecast and place weekly parts orders via PartSmart, STIHL iCademy, Honda PowerLink, EGO, Briggs, and screen suppliers.
    • Maintain critical stock levels for carbs, coils, blades, spline, pet screen, batteries, oils, and propane accessories.
    • Negotiate with vendors on pricing, expedited shipping, and credit for defective parts; track parts GP%.
  • Rental Check-In/Out & Propane Leadership
    • Oversee flawless rental contracts, damage waivers, demos, and inspections; ensure fleet availability ≥95%.
    • Monitor propane sales/fills: 20-lb, 100-lb, 1-lb exchanges, recertifications; enforce DOT logs and safety protocols.
    • Drive add-on sales (blades, oil, safety gear, delivery) to 40%+ attachment rate.
  • Repair & Screen Operations Oversight
    • Set repair turnaround standards; audit technician tickets for accuracy, photos, and upsell opportunities.
    • Ensure screen technician produces perfect custom and pre-made screens; maintain spline, frame, and mesh inventory.
    • Perform minor fleet PM and QC every repair before customer pickup.
  • Shop Standards & Cleaning
    • Keep shop bay, counter, propane cage, and rental trucks spotless: washed, vacuumed, fueled, and ready.
    • Enforce 5S organization, tool boards, locked flammables, and nightly lock-up.
    • Coordinate rental truck cleaning/prep and returned equipment detailing.
  • Financial & Compliance
    • Achieve departmental GP%, shrink, and labor targets; report weekly to store manager.
    • Maintain all propane CETP, DOT, and rental insurance compliance.
  • All other duties as assigned by store management.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Education
    • High school diploma or GED; technical certification (EETC, STIHL Bronze/Silver) a plus.
  • Experience
    • 2+ years rental/retail + small-engine/screen repair plus 1+ years leading teams; propane and parts ordering experience required.
  • Skills & Abilities
    • People leadership: grows part-timers into rental closers and techs into master diagnosticians.
    • Scheduling & ordering mastery: never misses a contractor morning or runs out of 2-cycle oil in peak season.
    • Customer service role model: personally turns “this thing is junk” into a $400 repair + rental combo.
    • Expert in rental software, parts portals, propane fill station, and repair invoicing.
  • Physical Requirements
    • Lift/move up to 50 lbs repeatedly (mowers, generators, 100-lb propane tanks).
    • Stand/walk full shift; bend, kneel, demo equipment, clean trucks outdoors.
    • Early contractor opens and occasional late repair pickups.
  • Other

    • Current propane fill certification (CETP or equivalent).
    • Weekend and peak-season availability mandatory.

title: Material Flow Engineer
description:
In this position...

You will manage the flow and movement of materials through manufacturing facilities to support production operations.

What you'll do...

  • Provide engineering support for material flow process; document standards and procedures, provide training, overall adherence and maintenance to ensure materials are available in designated stock, markets and line locations throughout the facility.
  • Work with Planning & Inventory Control, Production, Material Handlers, and Supply Chain to ensure robust policies are available and practiced and strive for continuous improvement.

  • Design and/or develops material flow processes and equipment.
  • Recommend changes to increase safety, reduce costs, improve quality and optimize efficiency.
  • Participate in plant layout activities.
  • Develop floor space analyses to confirm storage requirements and recommend practical solutions where required.
  • Assist in qualifying manual and powered material handling equipment requirements
  • Work to improve material flow and manage materials and inventory consistent with Lean principles.
  • Lay out market, sequencing, and kitting areas to facilitate material handling, process flow, space utilization, and labor.
  • Define and manages in-plant storage and call systems to maintain inventories; assists to define appropriate goals and metrics for proper material control.
  • Provide vehicle and pedestrian flow/congestion/safety analyses and recommend practical solutions where required.
  • Interact on a regular basis with other functional groups and vendors on technical and/or administrative matters.
  • Work with Production, Material Handling, and Plant Safety Teams, Supply Chain, Quality, Material Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Ergonomic Engineering, Civil Engineering, Vehicle Manufacturing, Body Construction Engineering, and other engineering departments.
  • Prepare detailed plans, generally spanning several months, vital to complete assigned projects.
  • Develop and approves schedule milestones.
  • Develop and coordinate labor, facility and equipment requirements for projects
  • Propose alternate plans for economic evaluation.
  • Administer technical procedures including process and work procedures.
  • Implement industrial engineering systems and processes (forecast cost data, capacity, establish shop floor control systems, and ensure containment of material movement within floor space).

You'll have...

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 5 or more years of Material Flow Engineer experience

Even better, you may have...

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering
  • Certifications associated with Material Handling Automation
  • Professional Recognitions and Awards reflecting accomplishments
  • Demonstrated experience working with all levels of the organization
  • Experience working collaboratively on teams and driving
  • Demonstrated leadership behaviors combined with outstanding interpersonal, teambuilding, and communication skills
  • Experience working or running production in a manufacturing plant environment
  • Tenure working in the automotive industry
  • Microsoft Office (Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Outlook/Access)
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD
  • Validated functional expertise in material flow
  • Strong understanding of lean material flow strategies & lean manufacturing processes

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? title: Senior Associate - Monitoring and Testing Quality Assurance
description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Associate – Monitoring & Testing Quality Assurance, you will be responsible for independently evaluating the quality, completeness, accuracy, and effectiveness of Monitoring & Testing activities conducted under the firm's Testing Program. The role performs quality assurance reviews across Control Testing, Substantive Testing, and Continuous Testing while ensuring adherence to firm standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

Additionally, the role will provide leadership and people management support, including coaching, performance development, capacity planning, and employee engagement for a team of QA professionals. M&T QA team covers all Lines of Business within JP Morgan (e.g., Corporate and Investment Bank, Asset Wealth Management, Commercial Bank and Consumer Community Banking) including corporate function.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Oversight of QA activities across Control Testing, Substantive Testing, and Continuous Testing programs. Review and challenge QA outcomes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to Testing Standards.

  • Guide teams in evaluating testing methodologies, documentation standards, sampling approaches, and evidence requirements. Drive calibration, standardization, and quality improvement initiatives across global QA teams.

  • Escalate emerging quality concerns, systemic issues, and control weaknesses to senior management. Partner with Testing CoEs, Testing Teams, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders to strengthen testing quality and governance.

  • Support the enhancement of QA frameworks, methodologies, standards, and procedures.

  • Provide oversight and direction to QA team members, ensuring effective execution of review activities and achievement of quality objectives.

  • Support workforce planning, resource allocation, workload prioritization, and delivery management across the team.

  • Analyze QA results and trends to identify emerging risks, systemic issues, and opportunities for improvement. Prepare and review management reporting, dashboards, quality metrics, and executive presentations.

  • Present key observations, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership and governance forums. Support internal audits, regulatory examinations, and independent reviews of the QA program.

  • Leverage analytics and data-driven approaches to improve QA effectiveness and reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to utilize tools such as Alteryx, Python, Tableau, AI/ML solutions, and visualization platforms to enhance quality oversight.

Required qualification, capabilities and skills:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Analytics, Business Administration, or related field.

  • 12+ years of experience within Financial Services, Compliance, Risk Management, Audit, Controls, Testing, Quality Assurance, or Operational Risk.

  • Demonstrated experience leading QA, Testing, Audit, Compliance, or Risk Management teams and managing delivery across multiple priorities.

  • Experience interacting with senior stakeholders and governance forums within a highly regulated environment.

  • Strong understanding of Testing Standards, Control Testing, Internal Controls, and Risk Management frameworks.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, or similar analytical tools.

  • Strong report writing and executive communication capabilities.

  • Experience working with large datasets, automation tools, and emerging AI capabilities.

• Maintain a clean and organized workstation in accordance with manufacturing standards

• Knowledge of ESD handling practices

Physical Requirements

• Ability to sit or stand for extended periods
• Ability to perform repetitive hand movements
• Ability to lift up to 25 lbs occasionally

Work Environment
